source.title: The ECHELON-2 Trial: 5-year results of a randomized, phase III study of brentuximab vedotin with chemotherapy for CD30-positive peripheral T-cell lymphoma
source.source_type: 5-year exploratory follow-up of a randomized, double-blind, phase III active-comparator trial
source.design: double-blind, double-dummy, randomized, placebo-controlled, active-comparator phase III trial

source_integrity_findings.location: Results, manuscript page 8, ongoing peripheral neuropathy severity in CHOP arm
source_integrity_findings.finding: The source reports 30 of 42 as 64%, 11 of 42 as 23%, and 1 of 42 as 2%. The counts sum to 42, but the printed percentages neither match the counts nor sum to 100%.
source_integrity_findings.handling: Preserved as a source-integrity finding. No corrected percentages were substituted into the atoms or SEA.

consistency_review.follow_up_definition_note: The abstract reports median follow-up of 47.6 months for the 5-year efficacy estimates, while the Results section reports median follow-up to last contact of 66.8 months (range 0-90). These statements were retained as different reported follow-up summaries rather than silently reconciled.

governing_source_execution.summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4: read and applied as governing SEA file
governing_source_execution.unslop.skill.md: retrieved from File Library and applied to prose artifacts

protocol_version_note: The governing filename is summary-evaluation-appraisal-protocol-v4-compact.md, while its internal heading identifies Integrated Compact v3. The file was treated as authoritative because project precedence names this exact file.
extraction_limitations: The source refers readers to the previously published primary ECHELON-2 analysis for some randomization and masking details; missing details were not reconstructed from that cited paper.
The extraction preserves central design, efficacy, safety, biomarker, subsequent-therapy, disclosure, and limitation assertions rather than every baseline characteristic or every forest-plot row.
Bibliographic entries were not atomized; they were exported separately as a reference task queue.
The trial was not powered for comparisons within non-ALCL histologic subtypes, and the CD30 analysis was post hoc and not powered for biomarker-response effects.
All model-extracted atoms remain needs_review because no independent human verification step is represented.
No external current-practice verification was performed because @VERIFY was not activated.
